text:
Maya P: Quick sync — vendor timelines have drifted a bit. Need alignment on testing windows, SI integration handoffs, and joint customer comms for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Who can join a 20m checkpoint tomorrow? :calendar:

Liam K: I can do tomorrow 10:30 PT. Main risk is firmware tag for H200 that blocks our perf kernels. :eyes:

Sanjay R: +1 for 10:30. Also need to confirm MI300 driver ABI freeze date from AMD partner team — currently targeting 2026-05-20. If that slips we lose one week of validation.

Tess L: Adding packaging/marketplace ask — marketplace image needs final kernel bits 48h before public announce. If SI needs extra time we should bake that into the timeline.

Maya P: Proposed short plan: 1) lock kernel/firmware freeze dates from vendors, 2) commit internal test windows, 3) decide canary day and comms embargo. Straw timeline if vendors hold targets:

HW | vendor freeze | our test window | canary announce
H100/H200 | 2026-05-12 | 2026-05-13 -> 2026-05-18 | 2026-05-20
MI300 | 2026-05-20 | 2026-05-21 -> 2026-05-27 | 2026-05-29
Gaudi | 2026-05-28 | 2026-05-29 -> 2026-06-04 | 2026-06-07

Liam K: Infra needs to reserve lab capacity (x8 runs) on 2026-05-13 - 05-16. I'll file a booking request after meeting.

Sanjay R: I'll ping AMD and request formal confirmation of ABI freeze and whether they expect a backfill patch. If backfill allowed include regression test in our window.

Tess L: For marketplace/partner packaging plan final image cut 48h before canary and docs draft 72h before canary. If SI integrations require certs we should surface that now.

Infra CI Bot: nightly-build: gpu-kernels/main @ 3666001240 - 4 tests failed (kv-cache, fused-mha). See logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4821 :warning:

Liam K: Those fused-mha failures could be due to API drift in the new H200 firmware. I'll triage first thing. Hotfix branch created: `hotfix/fused-mha-compat`.

Maya P: Next steps: 1) join 10:30 PT checkpoint (tomorrow) — I'll send calendar, 2) @Sanjay R confirm vendor freeze ASAP, 3) @Liam K reserve lab slots and triage CI failures, 4) @Tess L draft marketplace image cut plan. Use this thread for short async updates. :thumbsup:

Sanjay R: Pinged AMD + vendor contacts, asked for written freeze confirmation and estimated slip window. Will post reply here when they confirm.

Liam K: Lab booking submitted (req #LB-3982) for 2026-05-13 - 05-16 x8. CI triage in progress.

Tess L: Drafted marketplace checklist and uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/example/marketplace-cut-3666 — will iterate after canary date is locked.

Maya P: If vendors confirm no slip we keep the straw timeline. If any vendor pushes >3 days we reconvene and move canary by a week. See you at 10:30.
